name: Measurements corrected, a rebuilt drawing sheet, and an app that says what it stores
summary: Version 2.70 comes out of a full audit of the free download: wrong measurements and drawing views were fixed, exports were made safe to open, and the app now tells you plainly what it keeps and sends.

highlights.title: Measurements you can rely on
highlights.text: Tube walls, edge-to-face, arc and parallel-edge distances are now computed correctly, a part buried inside another is reported as interference, and distances taken on the tessellation are labelled as such.

highlights.title: A drawing sheet in true projection
highlights.text: The isometric view is a real isometric, views line up correctly for either up axis, curved parts get their outlines, bores show their true width, and the title block carries the scale, units and projection symbol.

highlights.title: Exports that open safely
highlights.text: Every CSV export is guarded against spreadsheet formulas, symbols such as ° and ± open correctly in Excel, and file names built from your model's name keep it in any language, Arabic and Chinese included.

highlights.title: Units read from the file
highlights.text: COLLADA and 3MF models open at their true size, STEP and IGES models are labelled in millimetres, and empty or damaged STL, STEP and IGES files get a plain message instead of a technical error.

highlights.title: Your data, visible and removable
highlights.text: AI features send nothing until you set up your own endpoint. The privacy dialog lists what the app keeps in your browser, and one button removes all of it. The licence is readable inside the app.

highlights.title: Hardened against hostile files
highlights.text: Part names, file names, project files and AI replies are always shown as text. They can no longer inject script into the app, its drawings or its reports.

notes: Every item above works in the single downloaded file. The optional local native helper was not re-qualified for this version; v2.69.1 remains its last qualified build.

Measurement changes: nested parallel cylinders, straight edge to face, vertex to circle, circle to circle, arcs, and staggered parallel edges. "Distance (parallel)" is now the perpendicular offset; the gap between the bounded edges is listed separately when it differs.
Drawing sheets: new sheets follow the viewer's Up axis; the isometric view shows no hidden lines and states its own scale when it differs from the orthographic views.
The 4K export is now called "PNG image (4K, Realistic style)". It is a raster capture 3840 pixels wide, not a ray-traced render.
Tolerance stacks: the RSS card, CSV and report say when a contributor uses a distribution that RSS does not model. The CSV states units and writes numbers to 12 significant digits.

Working in the app: Close all models now asks before discarding unsaved review work, Escape closes the top dialog, the Dark frame theme is readable, and the navigation bar stays visible in windows down to 930 pixels wide.
Tutorial narration: voices produced by a browser vendor's online speech service are marked "online" in the voice list.
Known and unchanged: touching parts are still reported as interference; nested STEP assemblies still show kernel body names; the tolerance panel prints eight significant digits.
